role: Burst caster - big hits, spreading burns [B]
rule: Fire runs on its own heat: fire reflux is a damage multiplier, and fire skills build it, scale with it, or spend it.

skills.name: Cinder Spit
skills.summary: A quick, cheap bolt that sets its target Alight. Weak cold; it is how you get hot.
skills.verb_fit: Ignite is "start a fire at a point": a coal that starts one where it lands. For the burst caster it is the builder: cheap, fast, and every cast heats you for what comes after.

good_modifiers.word: Blazing Spit: hits harder and builds heat faster
Catching Spit: the coal jumps on to a second body and lights it too
Rapid Spit: even less recovery
Cheap Spit: less essence for the same heat - pure heat-building

bad_modifiers.why: it already sets Alight; falls back to a little power
a coal in flight has nothing that lasts; falls back
its own opposite: a spit that puts the fire out as it lights it. Maths lets it act; it should not

skills.name: Kiln Fist
skills.summary: One enemy in reach: a heavy blow, 2 Alight, interrupts. If it was already burning, every stack is spent for +45 and the blow bursts, setting 2 Alight on everything within 2.5 m.
skills.verb_fit: Burn is "set a target burning": two Alight in one blow, and it cashes in a burn that is already there and throws it on to the neighbours.

good_modifiers.word: Furnace Fist: a hotter blow that leaves you hotter
Bursting Fist: a wider burst and more damage, for more essence
White Fist: all of it into the one body, the burst smaller
Banked Fist: hold it for a harder blow

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite in spirit, and it already interrupts: nothing to add, falls back to a little power
it already sets Alight and nothing on it lasts long; falls back to a little power
nothing lasts; falls back to a little power

skills.change_note: Burst tier: cost 12 -> 14, +40 -> +45 a stack, and the burst is wider (2 -> 2.5 m) and lays 2 stacks, not 1, so the close starter spreads burns. on_hit.status_s (5 s, Alight's own) made explicit for the duration aspect.

skills.name: Flashover
skills.summary: A short dash that leaves a line of flame for 3 s: anything standing in it takes 12 and catches. It does not carry you through enemies.
skills.verb_fit: Ignite along a line: the dash starts a fire everywhere you were. The burst caster's way out also lays fuel for the next burst.

good_modifiers.word: Smouldering Trail: the line burns half as long again
Lasting Trail: the line stays longer
Quick Flashover: a faster dash
Wide Trail: a broader line of flame

bad_modifiers.why: on a payload that repeats every tick it re-interrupts every tick: a permanent lock, not a modifier
a trail that drags everyone in it toward its middle every tick. Maths lets it act; it should not
a dash cannot be held, and it has no wind-up: falls back to a cost cut

skills.change_note: The trail now burns for 12 a tick (it only set Alight), so the power aspect has a number.

skills.name: Pyre Call
skills.summary: A short breath in, then every Alight enemy within 10 m loses its stacks, and each stack bursts for 45 in 2 m. Spread the burns first; call them once.
skills.verb_fit: Explode is "blast outward": every burn you set blows out at once. The burst caster's mass payoff.

good_modifiers.word: Roaring Pyre: bigger bursts
Wide Pyre: bursts reach farther
Distant Pyre: calls fires from farther off
Leaping Pyre: each burst lights one more body as it goes

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite, and it has no hit payload to pull with: falls back to a little power
nothing it hits to interrupt (no hit payload); falls back to a little power
one blast; nothing lasts. Falls back to a little power

skills.change_note: Burst tier: cost 12 -> 16, reflux 1.0 -> 1.4, 35 -> 45 a stack, and a 0.25 s wind-up (the big spell is read before it lands, and gives the speed aspect a number).

skills.name: Backdraft
skills.summary: Open the door. First every enemy within 5 m is drawn 2 m toward you, then the blast: they take 4 x the heat you carry above 20, and your fire reflux drops to 20. 320 at full heat; nothing when cold.
skills.verb_fit: Implode is "flame rushing inward": the air rushes in, then the fire follows it out. The burst caster's cash-in of its own heat.

good_modifiers.word: Wide Backdraft: a 6.5 m room-clearer
Tight Backdraft: smaller and harder
Sudden Backdraft: shorter wind-up
Quenching Backdraft: cashes in the same heat for more

bad_modifiers.why: Backdraft spends all the fire at once; nothing it leaves lasts. Duration falls back; Alight only partly lands
nothing lasts; falls back to a little power
it leaves no reflux to calm; falls back to a little power

skills.name: Bellows Breath
skills.summary: Hold: a cone of fire 5 m long and 60 degrees wide. 50 damage a second and 1 Alight every half second to everything in it. You walk at 45% while holding. 6 essence a second, and every second of it heats you - the fastest way to get hot.
skills.verb_fit: Blaze is "a fierce, spreading fire": a fire you keep feeding, spreading burns across everything in front of you.

good_modifiers.word: Long Breath: a 7 m cone
Wide Breath: a broader cone
Dazzling Breath: Dazes what it burns
Roaring Breath: bigger and harder, for more essence

bad_modifiers.why: on a payload that repeats every tick it re-interrupts every tick: a permanent lock, and smoke smothers the fire it is breathing
it already sets Alight every tick and has no wind-up; falls back to a little power
a cone is the opposite of one white-hot point; it narrows the cone to nothing useful. Maths lets it act; it should not

skills.name: Stoke
skills.summary: At once, +25 heat, and a gust of it: everything within 2.5 m takes 20 and catches. For 6 s every bare strike you land sets its target Alight.
skills.verb_fit: Blaze is "a fierce, spreading fire": you throw fuel on your own fire, it flares out round you, and it spreads to everything your hands touch.

new_mechanics.name: coat on a self_buff
new_mechanics.definition: Poison's coat key (poison.json, Venom Edge: every bare strike and ranged-weapon shot carries the coat's payload) used by a self_buff: coat {duration, payload} with no charges lasts its duration. Replaces Stoke's strike_status; Lightning's Static Coat and Metal's Red Iron use it too. One coat at a time.

new_mechanics.name: on_cast (radius)
new_mechanics.definition: A self_buff's on_cast payload hits every enemy within radius of the caster once, as the buff starts.

good_modifiers.word: Long Stoke: your strikes light things for longer
it acts on you: longer
Banked Stoke: lasts half as long again
Bursting Stoke: the flare round you is wider and harder

bad_modifiers.why: the opposite of feeding the fire: it cuts the heat Stoke exists to give. Maths lets it act; it should not
an interrupt on a buff's one small flare; nearly nothing to change. Falls back to a cost cut
a fire inside you has no reach worth a rune; falls back to a cost cut

skills.change_note: strike_status became a coat (Poison's weapon-coating key); a 2.5 m flare (20 and Alight) on cast, so the buff has a reach and lights the crowd before the burst.

skills.name: Slag Pool
skills.summary: Lobbed to a point, 9 m: 3 m across for 6 s. 25 a second and 1 Alight a second to enemies standing in it.
skills.verb_fit: Smoulder is "a low, lasting burn": molten floor that keeps burning whatever stands on it, stacking burns for the payoff.

good_modifiers.word: Long Slag: lasts half as long again
Dense Slag: smaller and hotter
Blazing Slag: hits harder and heats you more
Wide Slag: a bigger pool

bad_modifiers.why: on a payload that repeats every tick it re-interrupts every tick: a permanent lock, on a fire you meant to keep burning
a pool does not travel; no speed, falls back to a little power
no wind-up to shorten; falls back to a little power

skills.name: Hiss
skills.summary: One burning enemy within 9 m: every Alight stack on it goes out at once and it takes 50 per stack, all now. Your fire reflux drops 6 per stack. Five stacks: 250 damage and 30 heat off.
skills.verb_fit: Quench is "put fire out, and cash the heat in": it puts one body's fire out, cashes it as one big hit, and cools you for the next build.

good_modifiers.word: Cold Iron: more from each stack
Long Hiss: reaches farther
Choking Hiss: the fire goes out and so does its swing - interrupts
White Hiss: every stack cashed harder, at closer range

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: relights what it just put out. Maths lets it act; it should not
one moment; nothing lasts. Falls back to a little power
it spends the burn it would spread: the two undo each other

skills.change_note: Burst tier: cost 8 -> 10, 48 -> 50 a stack. Kind is smite (as built; the draft's new:seize). recovery 0.12 (the default) made explicit for the speed aspect.

skills.name: Wickpinch
skills.summary: Costs no essence: it burns 15 of your heat instead, and cannot be cast below 15. One enemy within 7 m has its flame pinched out: whatever it was doing is interrupted - even an attack not marked interruptible - and it loses 40 poise. A Censer-Bearer snuffed this way no longer bursts when it dies.
skills.verb_fit: Snuff is "put out one flame or source at once": one body, one flame, out. The caster's answer to a big wind-up.

good_modifiers.word: Flash and Pinch: Dazed as well
Choke the Wick: Slowed after
Long Pinch: reach the drummer at the back
Heavy Pinch: more poise

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: lights the thing it puts out. Maths lets it act; it should not
it costs no essence to cut; falls back to a little power
it deals no damage and leaves no reflux; falls back to a little power

skills.name: Flashpan
skills.summary: A flash of flame from your hands across a 90-degree cone 6 m deep. 30 damage, and everyone in it that is facing you is Blinded for 1 s plus 1 s for every 30 heat you carry (up to 4 s). Archers lose their aim.
skills.verb_fit: Flare is "a sudden flash of flame": the flash is the weapon; the hotter you are, the brighter it is. A caster's way to blind the ones closing in.

good_modifiers.word: Burning Flash: sets them Alight too
Wide Flash: a broader cone
Bright Flash: more damage, more heat
Long Flash: a deeper cone

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: smoke over the flash. Maths lets it act (interrupt and slow); it should not
a flash has nothing that lasts on the skill itself; falls back to a little power
a flash is instant; there is no wind-up to hold. Only the damage half lands

skills.name: Smokepall
skills.summary: Lobbed to a point, 9 m: a pall of smoke 3 m across. Enemies in it are Slowed, ranged enemies cannot see into or through it, and burns inside neither run down nor go easy: Alight on them ticks 25% harder. Lasts 4 s, plus 1 s for every 20 heat you carry (up to 9 s).
skills.verb_fit: Smother is "starve a fire, or a foe, of air": the foes choke and slow; the fires inside are banked hot for the burst you are about to call.

new_mechanics.name: zone dps_mult
new_mechanics.definition: A ground_zone's dps_mult {status: x} makes that status's damage over time tick x times as hard on enemies inside (the status engine's dps_mult key, read from the zone as well as from statuses).

good_modifiers.word: Thick Pall: lasts longer
Wide Pall: covers more
Smouldering Pall: lasts longer, and lights those inside
Ember Pall: everyone inside catches - and their burns are banked

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: a flash inside the smoke. Maths lets it act (Dazed); it should not
a pall does not travel; no speed, falls back to a cost cut
no wind-up to shorten; falls back to a cost cut

skills.change_note: Burns inside tick 25% harder as well as being banked, so cover also feeds the burst (and power has a number).

skills.name: White Heat
skills.summary: Dear and slow: a 0.6 s wind-up, then one enemy within 14 m is struck by a point of white heat: 150 damage and 60 poise, and your Heat bonus counts twice on it. Cold it is a good hit; at full heat it is the biggest single blow fire has.
skills.verb_fit: Sear is "drive all the heat into one point": nothing spreads, nothing lasts; every degree you carry goes into one body.

new_mechanics.name: heat_scale
new_mechanics.definition: The fire Heat bonus on this hit counts heat_scale times: a hit whose Heat bonus is +b does (1 + b x heat_scale) of its damage.

good_modifiers.word: Blazing Heat: harder still, and it leaves you hotter
Single Heat: all of it into the one body
Snap Heat: a shorter wind-up for the same blow
Spent Heat: hits harder and cools you after
Blinding Heat: the struck one is Dazed, so the next blow lands harder

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: a point that spreads is no longer a point. The jump takes power from the one blow
an instant blow has nothing that lasts; falls back to a little power
a slow burn on the hottest single hit fire has: the Alight is lost in the blow. Falls back

skills.name: Brushfire
skills.summary: One burning enemy within 10 m: its fire leaps to everything within 4 m of it. Each takes 30 and as many Alight stacks as the target carries, up to 3. Light one well, then let it catch.
skills.verb_fit: Catch is "fire leaps from a burning body to every body near it": one burn becomes a crowd of them, ready for Pyre Call.

new_mechanics.name: spread_stacks
new_mechanics.definition: Every enemy within spread_radius of the target gains as many stacks of spread_stacks (a status) as the target carries, up to spread_max each; the target keeps its own.

good_modifiers.word: Wide Brushfire: leaps farther
Roaring Brushfire: hotter, and you with it
Distant Brushfire: start it from farther off
Wild Brushfire: one more stack can leap

bad_modifiers.why: its own opposite: all into one point, when the skill exists to spread. The two cancel
puts the fire out it means to spread. Maths lets it act; it should not
a smaller leap of a skill whose whole point is reach; falls back to a little power

effects.Explode: reach x1.3; power x1.15; cost x1.15
